abilities.name: Tactical Retreat
abilities.text: The active Unit ignores the Disengage penalty for the remainder of the Round.

abilities.name: Terran Tenacity
abilities.text: Once per Game. Immediately claim the First Player Marker. No other player may claim the First Player Marker for the remainder of this Phase.
